WITH type_counts AS (
  SELECT ordertune, COUNT(*) as count
  FROM riskandmargin rm
  INNER JOIN orders o ON rm.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY ordertune
),
overall_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(count) as avg_count
  FROM type_counts
),
above_average_types AS (
  SELECT tc.count, os.avg_count
  FROM type_counts tc
  CROSS JOIN overall_stats os
  WHERE tc.count > os.avg_count
)
SELECT 
  AVG(count) as average_of_above_average_counts,
  AVG(count - avg_count) as average_excess
FROM above_average_types
